newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Tuesday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Tuesday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Tuesday:
Spokesman Nikolaus van der Pas said spokesman Joao Vale de Almeida would brief on 1996 Nobel Prize Jose Ramos Horta's visit to Commissioners Manuel Marin and Joao de Deus Pinheiro at 1600/1400 GMT.

Van der Pas said the document on the external aspects of economic and monetary union would be made available in the Breydel news room at 0930/0730 GMT on Wednesday. He said the other documents on the Union's economic situation to be discussed by the Commission on Wednesday would be available at 1100/0900 GMT.
Spokesman Jochen Kubosch briefed on the Court of Justice judgments.
In answer to a question, van der Pas said the Commission economic forecasts were not political decisions and that there should be no vote on these documents.

Asked whether Commission President Jacques Santer regretted his speech on Euroscepticism that triggered many reactions, van der Pas said the president had no intention to interfere in any national election campaign and that he had remained consistent in expressing his views on the inter-governmental conference. There is a lot of pessimism in Europe and the president felt he had to speak out on that, his spokesman said.

Asked about the legal base of the Commission economic forecasts, spokesman Patrick Child said they were not obligatory but very useful. Child also said the economic policy orientations were required under Article 3 of the EU Treaty.

In answer to a question van der Pas confirmed that the exports of gelatine were not permitted. Filippo di Robilant said it was foreseen that the Commission might discuss the gelatine issue, among a package of others, on April 30.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/329: Commission approves the acquisition of sole control of Mannesmann Hoesch Praezisrohr GmbH by Mannesmannroehrenwerke.
- Speech/97/94: Summary of speech by Commmissioner Anita Gradin at the European Parliament Civil Liberties Committee.
- Provisional agenda for the Commission meeting on April 23, 1997.
